caption: The drawing features two adjacent rectangular swatches of patterned fabric, each displayed vertically on a beige background. The swatch on the left is predominantly magenta with black floral designs and scattered black dots, interspersed with small blue circular elements in the center of each floral motif. Along the bottom edge, there is a narrow yellow stripe with a thin red line above it. The swatch on the right is deep blue with a small, repeated white motif creating a subtle diagonal pattern across the entire area. At the top right corner of this blue swatch, there is a large blue circle with the same white motif, almost blending into the background pattern. Both swatches are set apart from each other with a clear space between them, and the artist's signature appears in the lower right corner of the beige background.
title: Economy Samples of Silk
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
